text:
zoe (product-design): Flag: in-console docs panel calls it 'policy set' but docs and API call it 'routing policy'. New users get mixed messages in the guided setup.
ravi (docs): Oof. We updated docs to 'routing policy' months ago but UI copy stuck.
maya (frontend): The panel copies are from i18n ui.help.policy_set.title. We can swap key, but the help link points to /docs#policy-sets which doesn't exist.
kevin (devex): We should centralize canonical terms. I can add canonical_terms.json and expose to the i18n build.
ellie (support): We saw this in a ticket. Support used UI wording and sent customers to the wrong docs page.
a11y-bot: Accessibility: panel must trap focus; use role=dialog and aria-labelledby. Also ensure link text describes destination.
zoe (product-design): Recommend we standardize on 'routing policy' (matches API examples). Also change help copy to "routing policy (formerly 'policy set')" for 1 week.
ravi (docs): I'll add an anchor /docs/reference/routing-policies and create a redirect from /docs#policy-sets. Small PR today.
maya (frontend): I'll change i18n key to ui.help.routing_policy.title, wire docLinkService for the href, and add the a11y focus behavior. ETA tomorrow EOD.
kevin (devex): I'll draft the canonical_terms.json and open an RFC for where to live.
ellie (support): I'll add a KB note and a canned reply for agents.
zoe (product-design): Thanks — please ping here when PRs are merged so I can verify copy in staging.
